selectionBasis: The retained public-initial-observation scan recognizes CATR through the unchanged relational_chamber_projection source. This is an observed eligibility condition, not a solution, success claim or hidden game rule.
clockPolicy: Carried time plus wall-clock time since selectedAt includes preparation, diagnosis and retries. Do not reset the clock. Switch games when blocked for 2400 cumulative seconds. A successful campaign resolves this selection; later independent regression, browser and performance validation are recorded separately.
nextCandidatePolicy: At the deadline or an earlier unresolved stop, retain all evidence and select another publicly observed game with its own carried clock.
